camel_example: aliyun hbr AddCrossAccount --region cn-hangzhou --CrossAccountUserId 1589753625 --CrossAccountRoleName hbrcrossrole --Alias Source_account_1 --CrossAccountType CROSS_ACCOUNT
kebab_example: aliyun hbr add-cross-account --cross-account-user-id 1589753625 --cross-account-role-name hbrcrossrole --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --alias Source_account_1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCrossAccount

parameters.help_en: The UID of the account to back up
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role for the account to back up. This parameter is used when you configure a cross-account backup by assuming a RAM role
parameters.help_zh: 基于 RAM 角色扮演配置跨账号备份时，配置需备份账号的 RAM 角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

CROSS_ACCOUNT: Configures a cross-account backup by assuming a RAM role.

CROSS_ACCOUNT_BY_RD: Configures a cross-account backup based on a resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持：
CROSS_ACCOUNT：基于RAM角色扮演配置跨账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT_BY_RD：基于资源目录配置跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The alias. The maximum length is 32 characters. This parameter is not required for cross-account backups that are configured based on a resource directory
parameters.help_zh: 别名，最长为32位。基于资源目录配置跨账号备份时，不需要填写
parameters.name: alias

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The message returned. If the call is successful, \`successful\` is returned. If the call fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
